responsibility: Specializes the Arm backend for VxWorks targets. It defines VxWorks and CPU-family preprocessor builtins, option-override hooks, RTP/kernel-specific cc1 behavior, assembler and linker ABI/endian specs, start/end file and library specs, profiling hooks, structure-layout and relocation constraints required by the VxWorks loaders, stack-checking support, and the VxWorks-specific extra libraries and personality used on Arm.
same_name_distinction: Provides the VxWorks-on-Arm target configuration header—preprocessor builtins, specs, ABI defaults, and loader/runtime constraints—while vxworks.opt only contributes the recognized VxWorks-specific driver option names.
